summary: Iteration 7 (RBAC strict + username login + /admin/users + /outlets CRUD + logo setting + expense auto-binding) fully verified. Backend pytest: 22/22 passed in test_iteration7.py. Frontend Playwright: Kasir/Admin/Super Admin sidebar RBAC correct; User Management shows 4 user rows with toggle-pass reveal + reset-user modal working; Settings page shows Web Bluetooth Pair button + Logo upload + Multi-Outlet manager.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1238 lines (was 1049 in iter6) — still well beyond the 700-line soft limit; strongly recommend router split (auth/pos/admin/settings/outlets).
App.js is 1345 lines — same soft-limit violation; extract UserManagement, SettingsPage, Login into separate files under src/pages/.

SECURITY: plain_password stored on User row and returned in /api/admin/users response is an explicit tradeoff by user, but should be gated by ENV flag (e.g. ALLOW_PLAIN_PASSWORD_VIEW=true) so production deploys can disable it without code change; also add audit log entry whenever the endpoint is called.

Expense auto-bind for Admin/Super Admin roles does NOT populate shift_id (only Kasir path resolves shift). If Admin creates an expense while a kasir shift is open, expense will lack shift_id — may skew shift reports. Consider whether Admin expenses should also bind to the active shift of the current outlet.
POST /api/admin/users accepts empty password without validation — creates a user that cannot log in and stores empty plain_password. Add min-length validation.

PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/toggle can deactivate the last Super Admin, locking the system out. Add guard: prevent toggling the currently authenticated Super Admin or the only remaining active Super Admin.
GET /api/settings/logo returns value directly whereas printer settings roundtrip returns the value dict — consistent contract is fine, just document it.

The 401 console errors during initial page load on the login screen are noisy (from GET /api/auth/me before login) — swallow with a silent catch in the frontend axios interceptor when route === '/' to keep DevTools clean.
